non_production_boundaries: No new Y3 object, map, encounter, item, ability, runtime progression key or resource key is created.
Logical TT_SPEC progress identities, authority receipt shapes and session states remain offline-only and do not create persistence or a trusted runtime provider.

A forty-floor TianTing-side logical run candidate, five-floor Boss slots and four ten-floor creative major-Boss identities await upstream global-tower adoption; they create no accepted global floor count or runtime floors, maps, encounters, records, season values, reward values, source profiles, receipt slots or economy inputs.
No proposal, conflict, deferred or whitebox-candidate value is promoted to an effective runtime value.
Candidate layout coordinates, session galleries, preview images and logic-resource candidates do not create a current Y3 map, entrance, teleport, spawn, editor resource or runtime key.
Combat readability does not create skills, battle values, progression writes, credentials, source profiles, handoff routes or settlement inputs.

Enemy ecology and mainline Boss deepening only define readable responsibilities and interfaces; they do not create units, objects, skills, AI, waves, maps, authority writes, rewards or economy inputs.

Seven-star and mansion reference models execute only injected, process-local offline fixtures; they do not replace the authority contract or create real progress, sessions, time, credentials, rewards or settlement inputs.
Mainline narrative presentation only describes how authority-confirmed facts may be communicated; it cannot adjudicate entry, member state, completion, cleanup, progression, qualification or economy.

Object field reservation only defines logical source cards and all-null future bindings; it does not create y3-object-config assets or mode, plugins, stable object keys, copyFrom templates, resources, raw fields, runtime writes or economic effects.

The combat numeric unit baseline owns only dimensionless offline coefficients and naked-player reference snapshots; it does not assign raw Y3 fields, seconds, objects, waves, authority effects, economy inputs or tower values.

The Tianting endgame artifact contract only fixes optional single-slot positioning, semantic forms and future lineage/receipt preconditions; it does not create an item, ability, material, recipe, numeric effect, source profile, receipt or economy output.

The TianTing graduation artifact complete-design contract only freezes player-readable form responses, source-evidence shapes, accessibility and failure boundaries; it does not create an item, ability, material, recipe, numeric effect, source profile, receipt, economy output or runtime state.
implementation/growth/ remains an offline candidate; economy-v2 does not imply an authoritative runtime resource table, ledger, proof resolver or reward issuer.
acceptance_invariants: 天庭章节带必须精确为 Lv41-60。
通天塔必须精确为 Lv55 逐人校验与每 5 层休整。
玲珑塔不可与全局通天塔并列为两个长期系统。
天庭入章只可校验同角色、源自 DF_E_YANLUO_HALL 的不透明权威交接证明；不得消费、写入或注册 DF_PROGRESS_YANLUO_HALL_CLEARED。
天庭进度必须精确为入章、周天观台开启、常规主线完成三段 TT_SPEC 逻辑记录；三者均使用唯一生产者和 (actor_id,event_id) 幂等，运行时键为 null。
七星只能在周天观台逻辑记录后以单人会话进入；二十八星宿普通/噩梦必须逐人校验常规主线完成。
二十八星宿的方位只能由 Asia/Shanghai 权威时间基准在创建会话时冻结；客户端时钟、客户端方位与重试重算均不可接受。
塔首轮奖励只能外部引用 runtime-closed 的 economy-v2；四十层候选编排、五层 Boss 槽和十层大 Boss 创意身份尚待全局塔采纳，且不产生任何掉落、词缀、兑换目录、记录或赛季数值，implementation/growth/ 继续禁止消费。
所有规格局部内容角色必须使用 TT_SPEC_ 前缀且 runtime_key 为 null。
天庭战斗数值只能以独立合同中的无量纲 H0/A0/M0/I0/R0/B0/O0/S0 表达；绝对物编字段须等待完整实机标定门禁。
首轮五节拍合同只定义准入、顺序、第五节拍休整、结算/失败/退出/交接与幂等边界，不定义总层数或任何运行时内容。
七星必须精确为七个固定单人试炼；同星十枚残片合成对应星君称号，七称号自动解锁名称待定的集合称号；所有物品和数值仍非运行时资产。
七曜毕业法宝仅是与前序法宝共用唯一活动槽的可选高阶构筑收束；定序、辨序、开序互斥，不能自动反制、绕过挑战锁或把四圣噩梦变成基础毕业唯一门票。
二十八星宿必须精确为四象各七宿；子/辰/申青龙、丑/巳/酉朱雀、寅/午/戌白虎、卯/未/亥玄武，并在入场时冻结权威轮换快照。
噩梦必须保留七宿强化同方位四圣、四圣庇护七宿的双向关系；通天塔的五层 Boss 槽与十层大 Boss 创意身份仅是待上位采纳的天庭侧候选，不决定运行时楼层地图/实例、抽取、掉落、记录或赛季值。
主线、七星、普通星宿与四圣噩梦都必须可读地表达预警、决策、反制与可复盘失败，颜色不可成为唯一关键信息，且一至四人均有完成路径。
非通天塔敌人生态只能作为既有机制的可读放大器；不得降格复用主线首领、七星首领、二十八星官或四圣兽，也不得形成塔内容、波次、掉落、资格或经济输入。
南天门、断虹阵、四门失衡、周天观台与凌霄外庭五组主线首领级遭遇均须保留 P0 来源/关系、独立第二通道、串行单人解、可见反制与可复盘失败；附属压力不得遮挡 P0 或改写权威合同。
七星与星宿的离线参考模型只验证既有权威合同的准入、冻结、失败、清理与幂等边界；它们不产生进度、资格、掉落、称号、收据或 economy-v2 输入。
五组主线 Boss 的叙事与表现深化只能消费未来已确认的权威事实；双通道预警、复盘、镜头、音频和特效层级均不是运行时命令或完成结算。
候选公共路线、凌霄、七星、四方普通与四方噩梦空间只以 dry-run 形式存在；实际地图、入口、资源和逻辑资源保持未创建。
当前只有凌霄主线成功可进入既有零价值来源事实候选；七星、普通星宿、噩梦星宿、塔小 Boss、大 Boss 和完整 run 关闭不得成为 handoff candidate、资格或结算输入。
